user.title: Immich Frame Controller
user.description: Enter the controller URL. You will choose a frame device after pairing.

pair.title: Pair Controller
pair.description: Open [the controller setup page]({setup_url}) and enter the pairing code. If you already have a controller API token, you can enter it instead.

device.title: Choose Frame Device
device.description: Choose the frame device to add to Home Assistant.

device_manual.title: Enter Frame Device ID
device_manual.description: Enter a frame device ID manually. Use this if the controller device list could not be loaded.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the frame controller.
error.cannot_load_devices: Unable to load the controller device list. Enter a device ID manually.
error.invalid_url: Enter a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
error.invalid_pairing_code: The pairing code is invalid or expired.
error.invalid_auth: The controller API token is invalid.
error.no_devices: The controller did not return any frame devices. Enter a device ID manually.

abort.already_configured: This frame controller is already configured.
